root_idea.summary: The principal lexical branch of كيل concerns measuring and the regulated allocation of measured quantities.
root_idea.development: The measuring branch extends from measuring food or goods to giving and taking a measured amount, the measured quantity itself, and the instrument or capacity used for measuring. Classical sources also record separate homonymous branches unrelated to measurement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form كَالَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form اِكْتَالَ.
Displayed under the lexical citation form كَيْل.
Displayed under the lexical citation form مِكْيَال.

senses.definition: To measure out food or goods for someone, and hence to give them a measured amount.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may express measuring for another party or giving something to someone by measure; the complements determine the direction of the measuring transaction.

senses.definition: To take or obtain a measured quantity.
senses.usage_conditions: Often used for taking a measure from another party; with عَلَيْهِ, the construction can mean taking a measure from him or them.

senses.definition: The act or practice of measuring out food or goods.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the process or practice of measuring, especially in commands or transactions involving measured allotments.

senses.definition: A measured quantity or allotment; in كَيْلُ بَعِيرٍ, the amount carried by a camel.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense denotes the quantity assigned or obtained by measuring, including a specified load or portion.

senses.definition: A measuring vessel or instrument; a measure of capacity.
senses.usage_conditions: The term can denote either the implement or the capacity standard by which commodities are measured.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who measures grain and similar commodities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational or agent noun referring to one who performs measuring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a firestick: to fail to produce fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate homonymous Classical Arabic usage specifically predicated of the firestick or fire-drill.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rear of the line in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate military term for the back or rear rank of a battle formation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Form VIII taking-measure construction and its عَلَيْهِ / مِنْ relation are covered.
The agent noun for a measurer of grain and similar commodities is represented.
The measuring instrument and capacity measure are represented together.

cautions: The Form I translations “measure” and “give by measure” reflect related argument structures of the same measuring branch rather than separate lexical meanings.
The firestick and battle-line terms are recorded as separate homonymous Classical Arabic branches, not as developments of the Quranic measuring vocabulary.
